2609.11628.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks to Infer the Perpendicular Energy Conductivity in the Scrape-Off Layer of Stellarator Devices
2609.11628.paper_summary: In this work, we develop an inverse Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) framework to infer the dependence of the scrape-off layer (SOL) perpendicular heat conductivity on plasma density and temperature, $κ_\perp(n,T)$. The method combines radial profile measurements of electron density and temperature with the residual of a reduced one-dimensional SOL transport equation, so that the inferred conductivity is constrained by both the measurements and the underlying transport model. Three neural networks are trained simultaneously: two reconstruct the temperature and density profiles as functions of the radial coordinate and transported power, while a third represents the effective conductivity as a function of the local density and temperature. The framework is first validated using synthetic data generated from a prescribed conductivity function, allowing the inferred $κ_\perp(n,T)$ to be compared directly with the ground truth. The model recovers the imposed functional dependence with errors below $10~\%$ in the data-constrained region. Bootstrap resampling is shown to provide a practical indicator of prediction reliability and consistency. A scan in the number of plasma profiles used for training and the number of radial measurement positions per profile identifies a practical trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and data availability. Finally, the method is applied to an experimental dataset from the TJ-II stellarator obtained with the helium-beam diagnostic. This exploratory application provides an initial estimate of the effective SOL conductivity and illustrates the potential of inverse PINNs for extracting transport information from plasma edge measurements.
2609.11628.paper_summary_zh: 在這項工作中，我們開發了一個反向物理知識神經網絡（PINN）框架，以推斷剝離層（SOL）垂直熱導率對等離子體密度和溫度的依賴性，$κ_\perp(n,T)$。該方法結合了電子密度和溫度的徑向剖面測量與簡化的一維SOL傳輸方程的殘差，從而使推斷的導電性受到測量和基礎傳輸模型的約束。三個神經網絡同時訓練：兩個重建溫度和密度剖面作為徑向坐標和傳輸功率的函數，而第三個則表示有效導電性作為局部密度和溫度的函數。該框架首先使用從指定導電性函數生成的合成數據進行驗證，允許推斷的$κ_\perp(n,T)$與真實值直接比較。模型在數據約束區域中恢復了施加的函數依賴性，誤差低於$10~\%$。顯示引導重採樣提供了一個預測可靠性和一致性的實用指標。對用於訓練的等離子體剖面數量和每個剖面的徑向測量位置數量進行掃描，確定了重建精度和數據可用性之間的實用折衷。最後，該方法應用於從TJ-II恆星器獲得的實驗數據集，該數據集是通過氦束診斷獲得的。這一探索性應用提供了有效SOL導電性的初步估計，並說明了反向PINNs在從等離子體邊緣測量中提取傳輸信息的潛力。
